title: Add size, depth, key-count and operator limits to zEJSON() in src/tools/args.ts
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/src/tools/args.ts (lines 86-90), replace the open z.object({}).loose().transform(toEJSON) with a schema that rejects a payload before toEJSON runs when any of these holds: its JSON-serialised size is above an exported MAX_EJSON_BYTES (for example 1 MiB, and never above the configured maxBytesPerQuery); it nests deeper than an exported MAX_EJSON_DEPTH (for example 20); any object has more keys than MAX_EJSON_KEYS (for example 200); or it contains the server-side JavaScript operators $where, $function or $accumulator at any depth. EJSON type keys ($oid, $date, $numberLong and so on) and ordinary query operators ($gt, $in, ...) must still work. Keep the advertised ZodRecord public type unchanged so the MCP tool listing still renders. Add allowed and rejected cases to tests/unit/args.test.ts. Work on a feature branch off main; no deployment happens in this task.
acceptanceCriteria: `pnpm vitest run --project unit-and-integration tests/unit/args.test.ts` passes, and the new tests show that a 2 MiB object, an object nested 21 levels deep, an object with 201 keys, and a filter containing {"$where": "..."} each fail zEJSON().safeParse with success === false
The same test file shows that {"_id": {"$oid": "<24 hex>"}, "ts": {"$gt": {"$date": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}}} still parses and converts to an ObjectId and a Date

verificationMethod.description: The reviewer checks the PR diff for src/tools/args.ts and tests/unit/args.test.ts. Each limit must be an exported constant, checked before toEJSON runs, and covered by at least one rejecting test and one accepting test. The reviewer runs `pnpm vitest run --project unit-and-integration tests/unit/args.test.ts`; expected result: all tests pass with no skipped cases.

rootCause.description: The shared zEJSON() helper was written as a pass-through so the public API would advertise { [key: string]: unknown }, and it never got a validation stage. Every tool that reuses it gets no input limits.
